name: Debugging
about: Verbose logs, to find out why a model does not start or calibrate. While it is on, the server logs one line per request (route, status, time; never its text) and the engine's own output, which can hold what the engine prints of your prompts and the paths of your model files, and Settings > Troubleshooting turns the engine's output off or on. Keep the server's log private, look through a log before you share it, and turn this plugin off when you are done. A change applies when the server restarts.
